mapper.select: select id, name, item_type, item_id, url from lease.graph_info where is_deleted = 0 and item_type = 2 and item_id = #{id}
select id, type, name from lease.label_info where is_deleted = 0 and id in (select label_id from lease.room_label where is_deleted = 0 and room_id = #{id})

select MIN(ri.rent) from lease.room_info ri where ri.is_deleted = 0 and ri.is_release = 1 and ri.apartment_id = #{id} and not exists (select 1 from lease.lease_agreement la where la.room_id = ri.id and la.is_deleted = 0 and la.status in (1, 2, 5, 7))

select ri.id, ri.room_number, ri.rent, ai.id apartment_id, ai.name, ai.introduction, ai.district_id, ai.district_name, ai.city_id, ai.city_name, ai.province_id, ai.province_name, ai.address_detail, ai.latitude, ai.longitude, ai.phone, ai.is_release from lease.room_info ri left join lease.apartment_info ai on ri.apartment_id = ai.id and ai.is_deleted = 0 where ri.is_deleted = 0 and ri.is_release = 1 and ai.id=#{id} and not exists (select 1 from lease.lease_agreement la where la.room_id = ri.id and la.is_deleted = 0 and la.status in (1, 2, 5, 7))
